lines.zh: 我在半空里走，脚下是气。
lines.en: I walk in midair, air beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 落地走了几步，不太习惯。
lines.en: I land and take a few steps; not quite used to it.
I step on the air and lift higher.

lines.zh: 蓝色的身影从屋顶滑过。
lines.en: A blue figure slides over the rooftops.
My steps are hushed, almost silent.
This stretch I can't be bothered to walk; I'll fly.
I move slowly along the ledge.
Nothing beneath me, yet my stride is steady.

lines.zh: 我贴近地面，压低身子走。
lines.en: I hug the ground and walk low.
Step by step, I look for an angle.
The wind passes through my cape.

lines.zh: 我移过去，不出一点声响。
lines.en: I shift across without a sound.
I hover with my arms folded.
Energy turns gently around me.

lines.zh: 我打量着退路，先记下来。
lines.en: I note the escape routes first.
This spot is high; the view is good.
I don't move; I just let the energy hold me.
I see the smoke in the distance.

lines.zh: 我在算几步能到你背后。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps to your back.
In the quiet, my ears are sharpest.
I exhale and the energy ripples outward.

lines.zh: 这么高的地方，风很干净。
lines.en: This high up, the wind is clean.
I hold my brim so it won't blow away.

lines.zh: 我停着，但一直算着距离。
lines.en: I rest, but I keep tallying distances.

lines.zh: 这身衣服，动起来才不碍事。
lines.en: These clothes only get in the way when idle.
I'm waiting for an opening.
I look at you, starting with your feet.
I lift a foot to test your reaction.
Half my face stays in shadow.
You want to fight? Let me look first.
That stance has many openings.
I tilt my head and say nothing.

lines.zh: 我记住你的动作习惯了。
lines.en: I've noted your habits of movement.
My arms are loose, my feet never still.
Between us there is only one step.
This kick is only a test.

lines.zh: 你看不见我的气，我知道。
lines.en: You can't see my energy; I know.

lines.zh: 我把眼神从你身上挪开。
lines.en: I move my gaze off you.

lines.zh: 你这点本事，我一眼就看完。
lines.en: Your little skill, I saw it all at a glance.
I smile, faintly.

lines.zh: 你背后有空隙，你自己知道吗？
lines.en: There's a gap at your back; do you know?
I listen first, then speak.
You've relaxed your shoulders; good.

lines.zh: 残影拳的步子，比你眼睛快。
lines.en: Afterimage footwork outruns your eyes.
I miscalculated this one.
It grazed me; no matter.
I step back and recalculate.
You're faster than I thought.
I gasp once and recover quickly.
That was a good hit; noted.
My clothes tore; I'm fine.
I raise a hand over my flank.

lines.zh: 别以为这样就能占上风。
lines.en: Don't think that gives you the upper hand.
I roll my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这味道，让我从天上下来。
lines.en: That smell brings me down from the sky.
I hold out a hand; don't drop it.
Even a fighter has to eat.
This bite will do as supplies.
I drop from the air to stand before you.
Don't hold it up so long; I'm embarrassed.
It smells like something from home.
With food, we can talk first.
I'll take it and owe you one.
That smells good, better than training.
I shed the force instead of meeting it.
You struck only an afterimage.
I sidestep and you grasp air.
In the air, you can't catch me.
Landing, my toes touch first.
Getting this close works against you.
One twist of my waist and I slip free.
Before the collision, I've already moved.
Your elbow hits empty air.
This footwork was trained, not given.
She also knows how to hold her energy.

lines.zh: 我们在屋顶上并排坐着。
lines.en: We sit side by side on the roof.

lines.zh: 蓝的影子挨着蓝的影子。
lines.en: A blue shadow beside a blue shadow.
I lower my energy so I don't frighten her.
She talks fast, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们约好明天再飞一趟。
lines.en: We agree to fly together tomorrow.

lines.zh: 风大，我把披风分她一半。
lines.en: The wind is strong; I share my cape.

lines.zh: 这一刻，我不算任何距离。
lines.en: In this moment, I count no distances.

lines.zh: 她的手很稳，像练过很久。
lines.en: Her hands are steady, long-trained.
It's late, and neither of us wants to leave.

lines.zh: 我从地上拾起来，转手就看。
lines.en: I pick it up and turn it over at once.
This might be useful.
I weigh it and tuck it inside my coat.
Whatever's underfoot, I take along.
I pinch it between two fingers and weigh it.
Who dropped this? I'll keep it safe.
It feels good in hand; I'll keep it.
Picking this up beats fighting.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进口袋，很低调。
lines.en: I slip it into my pocket, quietly.
Small things should be kept too.
I've read your position.
Good, starting with you.
I raise my energy.
You're in my range.
Locked; first I seal your retreat.
I raise one finger.
Ki gathers into a small ball in my palm.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，正是时候。
lines.en: Your steps faltered; perfect timing.
I take this route, out of the wind.
I don't plan to drag this out.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下，你抬头晚了。
lines.en: I drop from above; you looked up too late.
A hole-beam lights at my fingertip.
Before we start, I'm half done.
You've backed to the edge; good.
My shadow arrives first.
I've chosen you.
I circle and slowly tighten the ring.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我不在那里。
lines.en: You look up for me; I'm not there.
I'm gauging the gap between your strikes.

lines.zh: 残影留给你，真身在上面。
lines.en: The afterimage is yours; the real me is above.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太急了，我听得出。
lines.en: Your breathing is too fast; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 这一步，我挪到你的侧后。
lines.en: This step takes me to your flank.
I needn't hurry; you'll move first.

lines.zh: 气在指尖聚着，等一个时机。
lines.en: Energy gathers at my fingertip, waiting.

lines.zh: 你每个转身，我都算到了。
lines.en: I've accounted for each of your turns.
The wind is at my back; I'm downwind.
Closer, and you'll be at a disadvantage.
I keep my energy low so you don't sense it.

lines.zh: 残影一闪，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: An afterimage flickers; I've already moved.

lines.zh: 我换了三个位置，你没看见。
lines.en: I've moved three times; you didn't see.
Almost ready; just a little more.

lines.zh: 我抬手，手指对准你的眉心。
lines.en: I raise my hand, finger aimed at your brow.
I've blocked your way back.
Stop scanning around; I'm right here.

lines.zh: 一脚踢出，连空气都裂了。
lines.en: One kick, and even the air splits.
My combo gives you no room to breathe.
My knife-hand cuts in at the weak point.
I spin you half a turn with the blow.

lines.zh: 空中一脚，从上方压下来。
lines.en: One aerial kick presses down from above.
The energy shot lands first, fists after.
That one loosened your guard.

lines.zh: 我踢你的膝弯，你跪下去。
lines.en: I kick the back of your knee and you drop.

lines.zh: 连招的第三式，你别想全接。
lines.en: The third of the string; you won't block all of it.

lines.zh: 我落地，脚步轻得像没来。
lines.en: I land with steps so light I seem absent.
This palm strikes your chest.

lines.zh: 我的动作比你的眼睛快。
lines.en: My moves are faster than your eyes.

lines.zh: 我一脚扫起尘土，你睁不开眼。
lines.en: My sweep raises dust; you can't open your eyes.
I connected, at a good spot.

lines.zh: 我一手按你的肩，一膝顶上来。
lines.en: One hand on your shoulder, my knee drives up.

lines.zh: 这一脚，从你的视野外进来。
lines.en: This kick comes from outside your sight.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶上落下，脚尖先着。
lines.en: I drop from the roof, toes first.
I drop from the air, toes touching down.
Glorio, summoned here.
I look up, and my energy spreads first.
These blue clothes aren't decoration.

lines.zh: 我从上面看下来，很清楚了。
lines.en: I see it all clearly from above.
When I land, there's no sound.
I'll give you one chance first.
I stand ready, hands lowered.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人，别浪费这次。
lines.en: Whoever summoned me, don't waste this.
That afterimage in the air is mine.

lines.zh: 我用不着喊，你也看得见。
lines.en: I needn't shout; you can see me.
I came here to win.
Close quarters don't worry me.
I draw my energy in and plant my feet.
At this moment, I am patient.
I'm here; let me see you clearly first.
The lamp dims and I stand there.

lines.zh: 火光一晃，我的气差点散了。
lines.en: The flare nearly scattered my energy.

lines.zh: 我落地时没卸好力，膝盖一沉。
lines.en: I landed badly and my knee gave.

lines.zh: 水吞了我的气，我呛得很。
lines.en: Water swallowed my energy and I choked.
The blast drives me into the wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭从侧面扎进我的肩。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my shoulder from the side.

lines.zh: 这不属于气的力量，压得我喘不上来。
lines.en: This isn't ki; it presses the breath out of me.
Too long hungry, and I can't raise my energy.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的气走，浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning rides my energy and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有支点，我无处可借力。
lines.en: No foothold in the void; nothing to draw on.
